ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.1). Adds a full-screen "Work Control" bottom tab with a pawn selector (player free colonists only), a horizontal scrollable lane of full WorkType names, add/remove/drag reordering, grey incapable types and a read-only result table. The lane and table sit inside a second outer vertical scroll, and the horizontal lane position is preserved when switching pawns. The first edit writes dense rank 1..N straight into each pawn's Pawn_WorkSettings priorities and calls Notify_UseWorkPrioritiesChanged, so the vanilla Work tab updates; per-pawn order is saved in a GameComponent. It also keeps the earlier work-type/giver ordering, split and merge tools, which never delete work types or givers. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Changes to the def-layer settings apply on restart. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
